thread:
tara: Heads-up — I'm kicking off a phased rollout for structured-output / function-calling (fncall) compatibility flags. Need quick ack + any blocking concerns. :rocket:

ben: timeline?

tara: Plan: today 18:00 PT -> internal smoke + 5 infra teams. then a 10% beta-org canary. Wed -> expand to ~25% external traffic with SDK opt-in. Fri -> default-on for hosted API, opt-out knob for Dedicated/Private. Will iterate based on telemetry.

ivy: guardrails? what are the safety checks and who owns them?

tara: Guardrails summary:
- SDK default stays OFF; explicit opt-in via `fncall_compat` in client libs.
- Server-side route flag `so_compat` to scope per-route.
- Auto-rollback if token-level quality regressions exceed thresholds.
- Daily regression alerts tied to the evaluation prompt set.
- Rate limits + circuit-breaker on schema mismatch spikes.

kevin: what about model-variant fallback if the chosen model can't produce function-shaped output?

tara: Fallback behavior:
- If route policy allows, auto-route to the nearest compatible variant.
- Else, return the legacy structured-output payload with an `X-So-Fallback: true` header and increment `so_fallback_count`.
- We'll expose `so_fallback_count` in Console + alert if >2% traffic within 30m.

ben: SDK changes: node/python/ts? semver bump? will older SDKs see surprises?

tara: New SDKs (node/python) will add `fncall_compat` opt-in and a compatibility shim. Semver: minor bump (new opt-in behavior, no default change). Older SDKs continue to hit old behavior. We won't flip defaults for existing stable versions.

maria: I'll own release notes + migration doc. Also need a short FAQ for support.

ivy: canary audience sizing — 10% weighted might be noisy for small customers. can we ensure a minimum org count?

tara: yes — sampling is org-weighted with a minimum of 3 orgs in the canary. We can also select a curated set of beta orgs for stable signals. I'll DM product to confirm the list.

tara: SDK opt-in example:
`````
// JS client
client.config({ fncall_compat: true })
`````

deploy-bot: Canary group created: `so-fncall-canary-18350` with 12 orgs. started at 2026-03-10T18:00:05Z.

kevin: what should we watch in the first 2 hours?

tara: Primary signals: p50/p95 latency per-route, schema-mismatch error rate, `so_fallback_count`, and top downstream consumer parsing errors. Alert if any metric >2x baseline or if parse-success <98% for smoke prompts.

ben: I'll add a smoke e2e: run 500 randomized structured-output calls and assert parse success >=98%. Will post results to the canary thread.

maria: I'll draft migration checklist + support playbook (how to flip flags, rollback steps, customer messaging).

tara: thanks — please ping in this thread with any blockers. If no major issues we'll iterate after the canary window and plan the Wed expansion. :thumbsup:
